notes.title: The long-awaited Echoes of the Sun is finally here!
notes.notes:
The long-awaited Echoes of the Sun is finally here! The release has just happened! Share with your friends, play the game, write reviews, and enjoy! 🎉🎉🎉

Supported platforms: Windows, Linux, Mac, SteamDeck, PC/VR

notes.title: Steam Deck native support
notes.notes:
We love handheld consoles! That's exactly why we've prepared a native SteamOS (Linux) build so you can take Echoes of the Sun with you wherever you go.
Additionally, that means, you can run the game natively on MacOS and numerous Linux distros.

[h2]The control map is based on Generic Gamepad.[/h2]

[h3]In-Game controls[/h3]

Movement - L Thumb 
Camera - R Thumb 
Jump - A
Grab - hold R2
Rotate - L1, R1 
Interact - X
Talk - X

[h3]Menu controls[/h3]

Menu - Menu button
Navigation - L Thumb
Tabs Navigation - L1, R1
Submit - A
Cancel - B
Save Changes - Y
Reset - X

If you have any additional questions, feel free to write it the comments

notes.title: More Achievements
notes.notes:
We’ve been hard at work and have prepared a set of 16 achievements, thoughtfully categorized by type, and integrated them into the game.

Types of achievements:

Blue – Progression achievements, awarded for completing certain parts of the journey and the main storyline.

Purple – Ingenuity achievements, awarded for unconventional puzzle solutions (yes, some puzzles intentionally have easier or more creative ways to solve them 😉).

Turquoise – Exploration achievements, awarded to those who love exploring every corner of the world and talking to ghosts.

More news coming soon 😊

notes.title: We continue to reveal the intro!
notes.notes:
📖 Plot: A previously unknown island has been shrouded in mystery since its earliest days. The island's guests are amazed by progress and magic, but the secrets were kept in the strictest confidence. However, both outside and inside the kingdom were dissatisfied... 
One night, Mia woke up to terrible explosions, screams of pain and fear. She ran to her parents and hid in a cave where her mother was to meet her on the other side of the island.

Stay tuned to learn more about our story and sketches. Each new frame brings you closer to the final world of the game!

notes.title: Add Echoes of the Sun to your wishlist and get ready for an epic journey!
notes.notes:
Immerse yourself in a touching story where a little girl stands on the brink of hope and despair as she watches her world collapse after a catastrophic solar explosion. She, the only survivor of this tragedy, has to restore light and peace not only on earth but also in her heart. Will she have the strength to overcome all the trials?

Echoes of the Sun is a puzzle platformer adventure game set in a unique post-apocalyptic fantasy world where you play as a girl looking for her parents among the ruins of a destroyed civilization.

Use telekinesis to manipulate objects and overcome obstacles that stand in your way. Solve puzzles of solar magic by combining the energy rays of ancient stones to restore the world step by step. Explore an island full of secrets and find out what really happened to your world. An emotional story full of challenges and unexpected discoveries awaits you.

This path will not be easy, but only the brave and pure of heart will be able to restore the world and make it brighter again. Add Echoes of the Sun to your Steam wishlist and get ready for an unforgettable adventure that will change the way you look at the world.

notes.title: We’re thrilled to dive into the gameplay mechanics of Echoes of the Sun! 🌟
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to dive into the gameplay mechanics of Echoes of the Sun! 🌟 Here’s what you can expect from our adventure-platformer-puzzle game:

About the Game:
In Echoes of the Sun, you take on the role of a young girl navigating a post-apocalyptic fantasy world, devastated by the disappearance of the Sun. Your mission: find your parents and restore light to the land.

Gameplay Mechanics:

Telekinesis: Use your telekinetic powers to manipulate objects and clear obstacles. This ability will be crucial for solving intricate puzzles and exploring the world.

Solar Magic Puzzles: Collect and use ancient stones to manipulate energy beams. These puzzles are key to activating solar magic and gradually bringing light back to the world.

Island of Secrets: Unravel the mysteries of a richly detailed world. Your journey will reveal hidden truths about the cataclysm and the fate of the world, blending emotional storytelling with intriguing puzzles.

Prepare for a game that challenges your creativity and problem-solving skills, all while offering a touching narrative. Echoes of the Sun is a quest of bravery and discovery where even the smallest hope can shine brightly.

We’d love to hear your thoughts and answer any questions you might have! Don’t forget to add Echoes of the Sun to your wishlist. More updates are coming soon. ✨

notes.title: Animation Update in "Echoes of the Sun"
notes.notes:
he world of "Echoes of the Sun" has become even more vibrant! We've updated the animations to make the little girl's journey through the ruins of her shattered world even more emotional and captivating.

Character movements are now smoother, and interactions with magical objects feel more natural. The use of telekinesis and manipulation of ancient stones now looks even more impressive, bringing each of your decisions to life on the screen.

These changes add even more depth to the gameplay and help you better experience the dramatic story of restoring the world. Get ready for new experiences as you embark on the journey to restore light and peace in your heart!

notes.title: 🌞 Dive into the story of our upcoming game, Echoes of the Sun! 🌟
notes.notes:
When the Sun disappeared, the world plunged into darkness. A young girl stands alone among the ruins of her homeland, watching the tragic end of her world and the explosive fate of the Sun. 💫

Burdened by her loss, she embarks on a journey to restore light and heal the wounds left by the Sun's disappearance. Along the way, she encounters remnants of her past and memories of her family, and each clue brings her closer to the truth behind the disaster. 🌌

As she explores this desolate world, she discovers long-held secrets and the hidden truth about the disaster. Her journey is filled with emotional moments and profound revelations, testing her courage and determination. 🌠

“Echoes of the Sun is more than just a quest to save the world; it is a deeply personal journey of healing and hope. Can she overcome the challenges and bring back the light? Stay tuned to find out!

Share your thoughts and don't forget to subscribe for updates! 🌟
